Name: paranoia_network
Title: Paranoia Network
Experiment: Players are divided into two factions: Informants and Misinformation. Each player has a unique role with special abilities that influence discussions and voting. The game consists of discussion phases where players share information and vote to eliminate suspected Misinformation members. During each Night Phase, players can use their abilities secretly. Players can communicate privately with the GM to express suspicions or intentions that may impact public discussions. Unique roles include Informant (can reveal one player's faction), Insider (appears as an Informant but aligns with Misinformation), and Decoy (can mislead one player's vote). Informants win by eliminating all Misinformation members, while Misinformation wins if they equal the number of Informants or mislead the majority.
